alasaka.p: Alasaka [na+lasa+a, ka-lā,(alasa-saṃ)] Indigestion; Alasaka disease where there’s indigestion and things can’t go up or down.
pn: Alasaka. The name of a disease, of which Korakhattiya died (DN.iii.7). Rhys Davids translates it as “epilepsy” and suggests that its name is a negative of lasikā, the synovial fluid. Dial.iii.12, n.2.
